name: Magpie
tagline: Magpie is a quiet Chrome side panel for saving images, screenshots, links, and notes into private boards stored on your device
description: Magpie is a quiet Chrome side panel for saving images, screenshots, links, and notes into private boards stored on your device. Unlike save-for-later apps that become feeds, Magpie appears when you need it and stays out of the way when you don't. No ads, account, or tracking. Capture content with a right-click, screenshot clipper, drag-and-drop, paste, or multi-image grab. Save X and Instagram posts with metadata intact. Organize with boards, tags, notes, search, and color filtering. Optional AI
